notes: Reviewed all 141 autoActions (approved the junk-certain removes, the dup-within removes and a handful of honest moves; 121 vetoes/amendments listed - most block word-homonym artifacts like 'translation', 'cell', 'molecular', 'concepts' that would have scattered non-biology lines into biology books and drained specialist registers). Adjudicated all 71 misAdjudicate items (37 keep / 25 remove / 9 move), all 41 dup clusters (26 keep-both / 15 consolidate - winners: microbiology x2, biochemistry x2, organic-chemistry x2, animal-physiology, anthropology, foundation-biology, economic-botany, plant-genetics, medical-microbiology, 3 all-junk clusters), and all 55 junkSuspects (9 kept as heuristic misfires - e.g. The 10-Percent Honesty, The Five Exam Families, Vegetation Types of the World; 46 removed/moved). Free-scan added 86 extras: 73 OCR-junk/umbrella removals (reviewer names, Lehninger/Campbell TOC mashes, acknowledgments), 8 honest moves (monoclonal antibodies to immunology, nitrogen metabolism to biochemistry, invertebrate intro to animal-diversity, ethology to animal-behaviour, renal disorders to internal-medicine, ART to obgyn, microbial metabolism to microbiology, metabolism preview to ch5) and 5 keep-confirmations. Developmental-biology ch1's injected NCERT human-reproduction block was routed to the medical shelf (obgyn ch1/ch4/ch5) with the umbrella dups removed; animal-physiology's human-clinical lessons went to internal-medicine/medical-physiology keeping the book comparative. No thin chapters; no clearly-wrong pedagogical order.
